title: ForecastSeries
description: One predicted variable for one subject, over the horizon. Names the variable, binds it to the subject it describes (hasFeatureOfInterest), and declares the unit as a symbol and as a QUDT IRI.

series_id.description: Unique identifier of this series within the forecast.

variable_name.description: Name of the forecast variable. Should resolve to a sosa:ObservableProperty named individual.

model_id.description: Identifier of the trained model that produced this series.

asset_type.description: Type of the asset, carried for convenience. Present only when the feature of interest is an asset.

unit.description: QUDT unit IRI for the same unit, as on QuantityValue (e.g. unit:KiloW).

hasValues.description: The ordered predicted values of this series. Unconstrained by minItems (see OrderDM.json's hasTimeStepOrders for the same reasoning): ForecastedValue.isValueOf is the required inverse of this field, so a minItems:1 constraint here would form an infinite cycle with no finite JSON instance - the top-level series always has real values in practice; only the series nested inside ForecastedValue.isValueOf legitimately has none.

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: The subject whose property is predicted: an Asset, a MeteringPoint, a Site or a Facility (as on Observation), or a Market for a price forecast.

observedProperty.description: The quantity predicted, from the shared observable property vocabulary.
